name: Aoi Hanga
description: Aoi Hanga — a store theme for a small woodblock print studio, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Moegi spring green (#A9C08B) is the main colour on the top-bar header, the hero band, the editions grid and every page head, set against sumi green-black ink; Mochiy Pop One for display and Kosugi Maru for reading. The hero puts the studio line on the left and the art on the right: a sumi-ink cut-out of a carved cherry block with a baren and knives tilts out of its frame and hangs past the bottom of the band. The home page is one long single column (numbered chapters on the block, the ink and the press) broken by full-width sumi-ink plates, then this season’s editions, the journal and the print letter. The studio details and the edition terms each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the editions show as static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-14 (single-column-longform, text-left-art-right hero, top-bar nav, full-illustration images, sumi-ink illustration, moegi #A9C08B, Mochiy Pop One + Kosugi Maru). Every picture is a sumi-ink raster illustration; the hero block is also a transparent cut-out that breaks out of its frame and the band. Contrast: sumi ink #1F2A1A on moegi #A9C08B 7.6:1 (all text on the moegi header, hero, editions band and page heads); ink on pale moegi page #F1F5EA 13.5:1; pine links #3E5A2A on #F1F5EA 7.0:1; moss #4A5640 on #F1F5EA 7.0:1; moegi on sumi footer 7.6:1; pale #EEF3E6 on sumi 13.9:1; deep moegi #5F7A45 on #F1F5EA 4.4:1 (large drop caps and marks only).

summary.zh-TW: 萌黃色的木版畫工作室商店：左文右圖的主視覺，去背的水墨版木破框而出，單欄長文介紹刻、墨、摺。
summary.en: A moegi-green woodblock print studio shop: text left, a sumi-ink cut-out block breaking its frame, and one long column on carving.
summary.ja: 萌黄色の木版画工房ショップ。左に文、右に枠を越える水墨の版木の切り抜き、彫り・墨・摺りを語る一段組の長文。
summary.fr: Boutique d’un atelier d’estampes vert moegi : texte à gauche, bloc gravé à l’encre sumi qui déborde, une longue colonne de lecture.
summary.de: Shop einer Holzschnitt-Werkstatt in Moegi-Grün: Text links, ein Druckstock in Sumi-Tusche ragt aus dem Rahmen, eine lange Lesespalte.
